title: BVLC management coverage for Write-Broadcast-Distribution-Table
purpose: Exercise standalone BVLC management parsing with at least one conservative table-entry-sized payload block instead of a header-only message.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP implementation should recognize the BVLC management function as Write-Broadcast-Distribution-Table and then validate the supplied table payload rather than rejecting the frame as header-only.
constraints_preserved: Standalone BVLC framing is used for a BVLC function target.
BVLC length 0x000E matches the 14-byte message length.
Message includes payload bytes after the BVLC header so it is not a pure header stub.
issue_safety_notes: The payload is a conservative fixed-size analogue for an initial management-table entry region, not an exploit or a known crash sequence.
